verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a separate sandbox environment. The CLI's `--env sandbox` targets api.gusto-demo.com with its own credential slot, separate from production api.gusto.com, and demo companies are auto-generated with employees and past payrolls so testing can start right away. Coverage is still partial: the separation is shown through the CLI's per-environment configuration and integration-partner docs, not a dedicated sandbox guide stating isolation guarantees. The CLI's `--dry-run` is only a request preview, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: dedicated first-party sandbox environment docs for the Embedded Payroll API with explicit production-data isolation guarantees, documented sandbox limitations/behavior (e.g., simulated money movement), independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Per-environment credential slots: --env production (api.gusto.com) vs --env sandbox (api.gusto-demo.com), each with its own slot in credentials.toml
Demo companies are automatically generated with company info, employees, and previous payrolls so you can begin testing right away.
